question: English as the official language of India for higher education was incorporated in the resolution formulation by ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Macaulay.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lord Macaulay** was the one who **incorporated English** as the **official language** of India for higher education in the resolution formulation.
 
• He was the **President** of the **Committee of Public Instruction**, which was responsible for the formulation of the resolution.
 
• The resolution was passed in **1835** and it aimed to introduce **English education** in India.
 
• Lord Macaulay believed that the introduction of **English education **would create a class of Indians who would be "Indian in blood and colour, but English in taste, in opinions, in morals, and in intellect.
 
• The resolution had far-reaching consequences and played a significant role in **shaping modern India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lord Hastings** was the **Governor-General of India** from **1813 to 1823.**

 
 
• He is known for his **policies of territorial expansion** and **consolidation.**
 
 
 
• **Lord Wellesley** was the Governor-General of India from **1798 to 1805.**
 
 
• He is known for his policies of** territorial expansion** and the **Subsidiary Alliance system.**
 
 
 
• **Lord Dalhousie** was the Governor-General of India from **1848 to 1856.**
 
 
• He is known for his policies of **modernization and administrative reforms,** including the introduction of railways and telegraph lines.
